content:
Context: 1. Classification of cities and rates.-

The term 'Basic Pay' in the revised pay structure means the pay drawn in the prescribed Pay Levels in the Pay Matrix and does not include NPA, MSP, etc.  
or any other type of pay like special pay, etc.  
- Resoln. No. 11-1/2016-IC, dated 6-7-2017, OMs, dated 7-7-2017 and 30-12-2022. PU
